def test_first_page_cursor_points_to_next_item():
    page, cursor = fetch_page(list("abcdef"), limit=2)
    assert page == ["a", "b"]
    assert cursor == "2"

    assert cursor is None

from client import build_client
from settings import load_settings


def test_default_attempts():
    settings = load_settings({})
    client = build_client(settings)
    assert client.max_attempts == 3

    settings = load_settings({"MAX_ATTEMPTS": "5"})
    assert build_client(settings).max_attempts == 5
